canonical_project: Beetaloo Digital Weddell Data Centre Precinct
notes: NT Territory Coordinator says Beetaloo Digital has a 12-month exclusive commitment over a 185 ha Weddell site for feasibility and approvals; proposal includes up to 2GW on-site gas power supporting up to two hyperscale campuses for AI/cloud/data processing and up to A$40bn private investment. Confirmed IT load has not been published.
